title: One-entry affine decoding with restricted outer pair counts with shortlist records in leader words and exact ranks through weight eleven

claims.statement: The explicit affine tag product encoder with the 1-entry relative-list pair decoder in proof.md has average block error at most 999797332977164003/1000000000000000000 on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses for uniform 1000-bit messages.
The same fixed bsc-ops-v1 program executes exactly W=2144 primitives on all received words, with W<=2^(1106609/100000).

experiments.purpose: Verify this sector of all local tag spectra and exact quotient ranks through weight eleven. The last sector also checks the global occupancy and the fixed schedule.
